newsitem.title: USA: Kellogg stock said off on soft U.S. cereal volume.
newsitem.headline: Kellogg stock said off on soft U.S. cereal volume.

text.p: Kellogg Co shares dropped to a 52-week low of 64-1/4 Friday morning after the company said U.S. cereal sales volume was soft in the third quarter, analysts said.
Kellogg shares at mid-day were off one at 64-1/2.
Analysts said they estimate that U.S. cereal volume in the quarter was off nine to 10 percent. A Kellogg spokesman said U.S. cereal volumes were lower, but declined to be specific.
Kellogg reiterated that it expects its fourth quarter earnings to be above the $0.77 it earned a year ago.
